# Dave Buys Houses

> Dave Buys Houses (DBHO LLC) is a local Indiana cash home buyer serving Indianapolis, Fort Wayne, South Bend, Kokomo, and Anderson. We buy houses in any condition, make a fair cash offer within 24 hours, charge no fees or commissions, and can close in as little as 7 days. We are real estate investors who buy directly as principals, not a brokerage.

Key facts:
- Phone: 317-526-4837
- Email: office@5minutescashoffers.com
- Service area: Indianapolis (Marion County), Fort Wayne (Allen County), South Bend (St. Joseph County), Kokomo (Howard County), Anderson (Madison County), and surrounding towns.
- Offer turnaround: 24 hours. Typical close: 7 to 14 days. Fees and commissions: $0.
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 by 347+ Indiana homeowners.
